walkthrough: Goal: ink over a reference picture using its colours, then deliver the piece: save it as a PNG and as a JPEG into a folder I choose, and send it to another app.

Entry: on the canvas the top bar's left end holds Gallery and, right of it, Actions (a spanner). Tap Actions: a panel drops down under it over the canvas (opening it closes any other panel). Header Actions; under Share: Save PNG… (Lossless), Save JPEG… (Smaller), Share PNG…, Share JPEG…; under Canvas: the Reference switch and Choose reference image… (Procreate's Actions > Share and Actions > Canvas > Reference).

Reference: turn Reference on. With no image yet the system's picker opens over the app, offering PNG and JPEG pictures. Back in the picker: nothing changes, the switch stays off. Choosing a file that is not a picture: the top bar says 'Couldn't open the image: only PNG and JPEG images can be used.' with OK. Turn Reference on again and choose a picture: 'Opening the image…' turns in the top bar while it is read (large pictures are scaled to 2048 px on their long side), then a window titled Reference floats over the canvas's lower right with the whole picture on white.

Move and zoom (since the G2 follow-ups): the window has no title bar. Tap it: a slim bar shows across its top (a move grip, ×) with a resize mark in its corner; drag the bar: the whole window follows and stays where it is let go, below the islands and on the screen. Pinch inside the picture: it zooms about the fingers' middle (1x to 8x) and the canvas stays still; drag one finger to look around the zoomed picture. A contact that starts on the window never reaches the canvas; outside it the pen draws as before.

Pick: tap the eyedropper in the side bar, then touch the picture: the loupe beside the finger shows the colour under it over the current one; lifting makes the last colour shown the current colour and the first recent one, the eyedropper turns off and the pen paints with it: draw a line, it is that colour.

Close: tap the window, then × in its bar: the window closes and the Reference switch turns off; turning it on again shows the same picture at once, without the picker. Choose reference image… replaces it. The reference belongs to this run of the app: it stays when another artwork opens, and is gone after the system closed the app.

Save: Actions > Save PNG…: the panel closes and the system's save dialog opens, suggesting '<title>.png' (Untitled Artwork.png); choose a folder and Save: 'Saving PNG…' turns in the top bar while the artwork is rendered at its full size and written (drawing goes on), then 'Saved “Untitled Artwork.png”.' with OK; it also goes when the hand goes back to the canvas. The file holds every canvas pixel exactly as the screen shows it. Save JPEG… does the same with a smaller file, quality 92, no transparency.
Share: Actions > Share PNG…: 'Preparing PNG…', then the system's share sheet with the picture; choosing an app sends it there, Back closes the sheet and nothing is sent.

Cancel and failure: Back or Cancel in the save dialog changes nothing and says nothing. When the file cannot be written (storage full or gone): 'Couldn't write the PNG file. Is there space left?' with OK; the artwork is untouched and can be saved again. A dialog that cannot open says so too.
Undo: exporting and the reference change nothing in the artwork, so they are no history steps; undo and redo are as before.
Reopen: after the system closed the app the artwork reopens unchanged, the reference window is gone (choose the picture again), the saved files stay where they were put.
Not here: Procreate's Canvas and Face modes of the reference, touch-and-hold to pick, export of layers, PSD or a transparent background, storing the reference with the artwork.
